purpose: Record durable project adoption of serial per-seed causal-universe research for prospective QROS/RISE campaigns.
adopted_invariant: Global hypothesis-pool ingestion, dedupe, causal fingerprinting and non-PnL prioritization are allowed. Detailed causal-universe construction, RISE-Q fixed-point audit, deterministic configuration freeze, economic backtest and gates are executed for one seed genealogy at a time. The next seed cannot enter detailed universe construction until the current seed reaches APPROVED_FINAL, REJECTED or BRANCH_EXHAUSTED, except a verified BLOCKED_BY_INFRASTRUCTURE checkpoint may release the queue without rejecting the blocked seed.
